item.title: Everyone Is Sick of Customer Service Bots. Here is How to Bypass Them
item.description: Edited by Asim BN.Are you one of the many people yelling "Representative!" on your phone lately? If so, you are not alone. There is a new wave happening in the digital world of consumers: patience is wearing thin for automated customer support. New data shows that we are approaching a peak in acceptance of cost-cutting automation. item.title: Twelve Countries Say No to Banning Autonomous Weapons
item.description: by Anna Fleck, Data Journalist - Edited by Asim BN.The United States and United Kingdom are among 12 countries opposing a global ban on autonomous weapons, joined by Australia, Belarus, Estonia, India, Israel, Japan, North Korea, Poland, Russia and South Korea. item.title: Which Roles Use AI More Frequently in U.S. Workplaces? Leaders Report Higher Frequency, Gallup Survey Shows
item.description: by Andy Kemp. Edited by Asim BN.U.S. employees already using artificial intelligence (AI) in the workplace used it slightly more often in the fourth quarter of 2025 than in the prior quarter, continuing a gradual increase since 2023. The proportion of employees using AI daily has risen from 10% to 12%. Frequent use, defined as using AI at work at least a few times a week, has also inched up three percentage points to 26%. These increases are on par with the expansion of frequent workplace AI use
